title: DocGuard precision evidence
description: Benchmark evidence for finding codes. The root describes the `precisionEvidence` block that `docguard guard --format json` attaches to its result, scoped to the codes that run emitted; `$defs.artifact` describes the generated module the block is served from. The unit of evidence is the finding code. DocGuard defines many more codes than its corpus measures, so a code the corpus never exercised reports `not-measured`, carries no number, and never inherits the measured precision of another code in the same validator. Only a measured code may fall back to a coarser measured tier, and the fallback names that tier. Every ratio is benchmark precision on a deliberately balanced labelled corpus — not the probability that a finding in a user's repository is real.

toolVersion.description: The DocGuard version the benchmark ran on.

matchesRunningVersion.description: False means the numbers were measured on a different build than the one reporting them, which a reader must be told.

detectorsDigest.description: Digest of the detector sources the corpus was run against. Lets a consumer tell a version bump from a behaviour change.

detectorCalibration.description: Whether the detectors that produced this report are the ones measured: `unchanged` means the numbers still apply to the running build, `changed` means they may not, `unknown` means it could not be determined and must not be read as unchanged.

coverage.description: How much of what this run reported has ever been benchmarked. `notMeasured` is expected to dominate and is the honest headline.

quotable.description: Measured codes whose own precision denominator reaches minN.

adjudicated.description: Reviewed disagreements on record across the codes in this run. Visible beside the rates and counted inside none of them.

measures.description: What every ratio is. Deliberately not a claimspec `calibration` kind: that names P(event) under a real base rate, and a balanced corpus has none.

caveat.description: The sentence a consumer must show beside any quoted ratio.

minN.description: Smallest precision denominator a point estimate may be quoted from.

wilson.description: Wilson 95% interval as [lower, upper], or null when the denominator is zero.

adjudicated.description: Reviewed disagreements on record for this scope. Counted beside every rate and inside none of them: a case where the detector fired as designed and a user disagreed belongs in neither a numerator nor a denominator.

quotable.description: True when `precisionDenominator` reaches minN. False means the point estimate must not be repeated on its own.

oneOf.title: Not measured
oneOf.description: No benchmark case exercises this code. It carries no number and no backoff: inheriting its validator's measured precision would invent evidence.

backoff.description: A coarser measured tier, present only when this code's own denominator is below minN and the coarser tier reaches it. Null otherwise.

artifact.description: The generated module's object (cli/precision-evidence-data.mjs), derived from benchmarks/baseline.json. `byCode` holds only measured codes; absence is what `not-measured` is served from.

detectorsDigest.description: Digest of the detector sources the corpus was run against. Lets a consumer tell a version bump from a behaviour change.
